newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina not mulling selling YPF shares- official.
newsitem.headline: Argentina not mulling selling YPF shares- official.

text.p: The Argentine government is not considering selling its remaining 20 percent share in oil firm YPF, Finance Under Secretary Pablo Guidotti said Monday.
Guidotti told reporters that investors should not get excited about the prospect of buying the government's stake in YPF, which it keeps in a regional development trust fund.
"At this moment, we are not thinking of selling those shares...the YPF shares in the regional development trust fund are going to stay there for a couple of years longer."
Economy Minister Roque Fernandez said last November that the government was considering issuing bonds backed by its shares in YPF.
